make_dataset: create a dataset from a given path using lazy, cached, raw, or mmap implementation
make_builder: build an IndexedDatasetBuilder or MMapIndexedDatasetBuilder for writing indexed dataset files to disk
infer_dataset_impl: infer the dataset implementation type from an existing dataset path by reading its index file magic bytes
MMapIndexedDataset: load and index a memory-mapped dataset for efficient random access without loading full data into RAM
IndexedDatasetBuilder: build a TorchNet indexed dataset by adding tensor items and finalizing with an index file
